text: data stays inside a compact control region
textPreview: data stays inside a compact control region

text:
Do not claim that iterators are always slow or that compilation must remove every abstraction. Neumann's motivation is that per-tuple operator calls can harm locality and branch predictability; compilation can blur boundaries and keep data in a compact pipeline. This course first makes the boundaries explicit, then studies alternative lowerings.

text: We use Rust because the representation and cost model become discussable—not because Python is “bad.”
textPreview: We use Rust because the representation and cost model become discussable—not because Python is “bad.”

text:
Frame this as a pedagogical choice. Python remains useful for data exploration; Rust forces us to state ownership, borrowing, and exact representation. Those constraints make storage, iterators, and typed program values visible in the compiler.

text: An enum variant is not a subclass. Exhaustive match means every language case is handled.
textPreview: An enum variant is not a subclass. Exhaustive match means every language case is handled.

text:
Teach the mathematical distinction explicitly. A struct is a product: all fields are present. An enum is a tagged sum: one alternative is present. This is why grammar cases map naturally to enum variants and why exhaustive matching is a compiler-design aid.
